in_sanskrit.name: सम
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: समस्याकार्त्रियम् (sama-samyakarta-ryam) - one who is free from partiality and treats all equally.

in_hindi.name: समूह
in_hindi.long_meaning: समूह (samuh) - a collective body of individuals or a community with a common interest or goal.

in_tamil.name: சமு
in_tamil.long_meaning: சமு (samu) - existing or happening together with something else; accompanying or accompanying someone.

in_telugu.name: శము
in_telugu.long_meaning: శము (shamu) - a state of mental peace and calmness; a sense of tranquility or serenity.

in_marathi.name: Samu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Samu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who protects or is a deity. Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘sama’ meaning ‘equal’ or ‘protect’ and the suffix ‘u’ indicating a male or a god.

in_bengali.name: Samu
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Protector, God
in_bengali.long_meaning: Samu একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who protects or is a deity. Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘sama’ meaning ‘equal’ or ‘protect’ and the suffix ‘u’ indicating a male or a god.
